idleSub: Walk around. Concepts will find you.
pausedSub: Click or press Enter to keep going.
editingSub: The game is paused while you edit.
emptySub: Add some content to this game to make it playable.
copyNote: Copied. Paste it where you need it.
copyFail: The text is selected. Copy it with Ctrl or Cmd + C.
stageLabel: Overworld game. Walk the character around. Concepts will challenge you with questions.
stageHow: Walk with the arrow keys or W A S D. Press N to walk to the next house. When a concept appears, press 1 to 4 or Tab and Enter to answer. Press Tab to move on. The full text is also under Read it without playing.
hintKeys: Arrows or WASD to walk. N for the next house.
hintTouch: Tap the map or use the pad
guideText: Walk around. Concepts will find you, or knock on a locked house to meet one.
knockedOut: Knocked out! It retreated. Your hearts are back, so try again.
knockedDialog: {name} got away. Knock on its house to face it again.
